## Summary

A short description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Motivation

Why is this feature useful? What problem does it solve? Who would benefit from it?

## Proposed Solution

Describe how you think this could be implemented. Diagrams, mockups, or pseudocode are welcome.

## Alternatives Considered

Any alternative solutions or features you have considered, and why you think this approach is better.

## Additional Context

Any other context, links, or references that might help evaluate this request.
